title: Cross-Country Flight Distance Log
dataSources: Pilot logbook (`flightlog:entry`), avionics telemetry (`avionics:telemetry`), flight-sim sessions (`flightsim:session`), pre-flight checklists (`preflight:check`).
app: Pilot and flight-sim telemetry — electronic logbooks (ForeFlight, LogTen Pro), Stratux / GDL90 avionics receivers, and Microsoft Flight Simulator / X-Plane SimConnect sessions — streamed to Splunk HEC via scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=flightlog:entry
| where distance_nm>50
| bin _time span=1y
| stats sum(distance_nm) as nm, count as xc_flights by _time
| sort - _time
description: Totals your cross-country flying distance each year, tracking the long trips that build real experience.
value: Cross-country hours are milestones for pilots; totalling them shows how your range and confidence grow.
implementation: Ingest logbook entries into `index=personal`; total cross-country distance annually.
visualization: Column chart of yearly cross-country distance.
grandmaExplanation: It adds up the long flights you make each year, tracking the trips that build real flying experience.
